nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 同一诉求的不同表达
nodes.message:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

Is a growing asset queue leaving your artists less time to refine the game?

Tripo Studio Team Plan helps your game team create first-pass 3D characters and props from text or images, pool credits and reuse assets in one workspace. Artists still refine and approve what ships.

Plan a 10-asset pilot against your current process: generation, cleanup, review and reuse. Discuss your asset list and trial availability.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

资产制作需求不断增加，是否挤占了美术成员完善游戏的时间？

Tripo Studio 团队版支持游戏团队从文字或图片生成角色与道具的初始3D模型，共享积分，并在同一工作区复用资产。最终用于项目的资产，仍由美术成员精修并审核。

规划一次包含10项真实资产的试点，对照现有流程，评估生成、精修、审核与复用的投入。沟通你的资产清单及可用的试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 生成起点与团队交付
nodes.message:
Generate first-pass models from text or images, then let artists refine them in their existing tools and check them in the game.

Shared credits, access controls and a searchable asset library keep team resources together. Another teammate can find and reuse reviewed work rather than request a new file.

Plan a 10-asset pilot to compare the whole process with how your team works today. Leave your details to discuss the plan and trial availability.
nodes.messageZh:
从文字或图片生成初始模型，再由美术成员在现有工具中精修，并在游戏中检查。

共享积分、访问权限管理和可搜索的资产库，让团队资源集中管理。另一位成员可以查找并复用已审核的资产，减少重新索取文件的环节。

规划包含10项资产的试点，把完整流程与团队现有做法进行比较。留下联系方式，沟通试点计划及可用的试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 10项资产的完整投入
nodes.message:
Choose 10 real characters and props. Define what counts as useful and approved for your game.

Compare your current workflow with a pilot: time to first useful model, generation credits and retries, artist cleanup, review and engine checks. Record whether another teammate can find and reuse each approved asset.

Count the full effort, not just generation time. Leave your details to discuss a pilot plan and trial availability.
nodes.messageZh:
选择10项真实角色与道具，先明确什么样的模型算可继续制作、什么样的资产算通过游戏项目验收。

对照现有流程与试点：记录首个可继续制作的模型所需时间、生成积分与重试、美术精修、审核及引擎检查；再记录另一位成员能否找到并复用每项已审核的资产。

统计完整投入，而不只看生成时间。留下联系方式，沟通试点计划及可用的试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 同一诉求的不同表达
nodes.message:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

Can the characters and props on your roadmap make it into the game, not just a preview?

Tripo Studio Team Plan starts with the characters and props your game needs. Generate initial 3D models from text or images, refine them in your existing tools, then keep reviewed assets in a shared workspace.

Plan a 10-asset project pilot: check in-game use, artist effort and team reuse before choosing what ships. Discuss your project and trial availability.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

规划中的角色与道具，能否真正进入游戏，而不只停在预览图中？

Tripo Studio 团队版从游戏实际需要的角色与道具入手：从文字或图片生成初始3D模型，在现有工具中精修，再将已审核的资产保留在共享工作区。

规划包含10项资产的项目试点，评估游戏内使用、美术投入及团队复用，再决定哪些资产可用于交付。沟通你的项目需求及可用的试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 进入真实游戏场景
nodes.message:
Start with characters and props planned for a game scene. Generate initial models, then have artists refine geometry and materials in their existing tools.

Check scale, mesh budget, materials and any required animation in the project. Keep approved assets in the shared library for the team to reuse.

Plan a 10-asset pilot around this path, not just a gallery of outputs. Leave your details to discuss the project and trial availability.
nodes.messageZh:
从某个游戏场景计划使用的角色与道具开始。生成初始模型，再由美术成员在现有工具中完善几何与材质。

在项目中检查比例、面数预算、材质及所需动画。将通过验收的资产保留在共享资产库，方便团队复用。

围绕这条项目路径规划包含10项资产的试点，而不只是展示一组生成图。留下联系方式，沟通项目需求及可用的试用安排。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 按游戏项目验收10项资产
nodes.message:
Pick 10 characters and props with a defined use in your game. Set project checks before generating: visual fit, mesh budget, materials and animation where needed.

Compare your current process with the pilot. Include generation, retries, artist refinement, review and in-game checks; record which assets pass and can be reused.

This tests project fit, not guaranteed savings. Leave your details to discuss the pilot and trial availability.
nodes.messageZh:
选择10项在游戏中有明确用途的角色与道具。生成前先确定项目检查要求：视觉适配、面数预算、材质，以及必要时的动画要求。

对照现有制作流程与试点，计入生成、重试、美术精修、审核及游戏内检查，并记录哪些资产通过验收、可以复用。

这用于判断方案是否适合项目，不代表保证节省。留下联系方式，沟通试点及可用的试用安排。

nodes.message:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

Could your game asset tools offer 3D generation without your team building the underlying model stack?

Use Tripo API as the 3D generation layer in your tools, rather than building the underlying model stack. Submit text or images, track asynchronous tasks and retrieve models. Your team controls the interface, asset review and engine checks.

Plan a 10-asset API test to compare quality, retries, cleanup time and total cost before scaling.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

游戏资产工具需要3D生成功能，是否一定要让团队从头搭建底层生成模型？

把Tripo API作为工具中的3D生成层，不必从头搭建底层生成模型。提交文字或图片，查询异步任务状态，再取回模型；交互界面、资产审核和引擎检查仍由你的团队掌控。

先规划一次10项真实资产的API测试，对比质量、重试、精修时间和总成本，再决定是否扩大使用。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 接入生成层，保留项目验收
nodes.message:
Your tool submits text or images and receives a task ID. It checks status and retrieves the model after a successful task. Your team reviews geometry, materials and target-engine performance before approving the asset.

Tripo provides the generation layer; your team implements the interface and integration. Open Quick Start for the request flow.
nodes.messageZh:
你的工具提交文字或图片并取得任务ID，再查询状态，在任务成功后取回模型。团队检查几何、材质和目标引擎中的性能，决定资产是否通过验收。

Tripo提供生成层；交互界面和系统接入由你的团队实现。打开 Quick Start，查看请求流程。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 规划10项真实资产评估
nodes.message:

This is an evaluation plan, not a running benchmark. Open Quick Start when your team is ready to implement.
nodes.messageZh:

variants.subject: Add 3D generation to your product content platform
variants.subjectZh: 为产品内容平台接入3D生成层

nodes.labelZh: 开场 · 同一诉求的不同表达
nodes.message:
Hi, we’re Tripo.

Could your content platform create 3D product assets without your team building the underlying generation model?

Use Tripo API as the 3D generation layer in your content platform, rather than building the underlying model stack. Submit product images, track asynchronous tasks and retrieve models. Your team controls the viewer, product review and publishing.

Plan a 10-asset API test to compare fidelity, retries, correction time and total cost before expanding.
nodes.messageZh:
你好，我们是 Tripo。

为内容平台加入3D产品资产生成，是否一定要让团队从头搭建底层生成模型？

把Tripo API作为内容平台中的3D生成层，不必从头搭建底层生成模型。提交产品图片，查询异步任务状态，再取回模型；查看器、产品准确性审核和发布仍由你的团队掌控。

先规划一次10款真实产品的API测试，对比还原度、重试、人工修正时间和总成本，再决定是否扩大使用。

buttons.label: See product workflow
buttons.labelZh: 查看产品展示接入流程

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 生成结果如何接入产品展示
nodes.message:
Your platform submits product images and receives a task ID. It checks status and retrieves the model after a successful task. Review shape, proportions and materials against the real product, then connect approved assets to your display.

Tripo provides the generation layer; your team implements the viewer and publishing workflow. Open Quick Start for the request flow.
nodes.messageZh:
平台提交产品图片并取得任务ID，再查询状态，在任务成功后取回模型。对照实物检查形态、比例与材质，再把验收通过的资产接入产品展示。

Tripo提供生成层；查看器和发布流程由你的团队实现。打开 Quick Start，查看请求流程。

nodes.labelZh: 回复 · 规划10款真实产品评估
nodes.message:
Choose 10 real products covering common and difficult shapes or materials. Define display requirements and review outputs against the originals. Record time to first approved output, accepted assets, retries, manual corrections and API cost, plus viewer and integration work.

Compare the total effort with your current content process. This is a test plan, not a running benchmark. Open Quick Start to prepare implementation.
nodes.messageZh:
选择10款真实产品，覆盖常见及难处理的形态或材质。明确展示要求，并对照原产品审核输出；记录首个验收通过输出所需时间、通过验收的资产、重试、人工修正和API费用，同时计入查看器及系统接入的开发工作。

对比现有内容流程的总投入。这里提供测试方案，不会直接启动测试；打开 Quick Start，准备实施。
